details: The Federal Reserve unanimously maintained interest rates at 3.50%-3.75% during its June 17, 2026 meeting, marking the fourth consecutive hold. New Chair Kevin Warsh, in his debut press conference, emphasized price stability and notably removed language that had previously hinted at future rate cuts. This shift indicates a "higher-for-longer" policy outlook, creating persistent headwinds for leveraged positions in crypto markets and other risk assets due to higher opportunity costs.
title: Fed Holds Rates, Chair Warsh Signals Hawkish Stance on Inflation

details: Following the Federal Reserve's June 17, 2026 policy meeting, updated economic projections revealed that some policymakers anticipate inflation remaining above target, with a possibility of an additional rate hike before the year-end. This hawkish "dot plot" reinforces expectations of prolonged restrictive monetary policy. Such a scenario could lead to a stronger U.S. dollar and higher Treasury yields, reducing the appeal of riskier assets like cryptocurrencies for capital allocation.
title: Fed Dot Plot Hints at Possible Rate Hike Amid Persistent Inflation

details: The U.S. Senate passed legislation (the "21st Century ROAD to Housing Act") on June 17, 2026, with an 89-10 vote, prohibiting the Federal Reserve from issuing a central bank digital currency (CBDC) until at least December 31, 2030. This bipartisan bill explicitly protects private, permissionless dollar-backed stablecoins, granting issuers like Tether (USDT) and Circle (USDC) a significant opportunity to expand their payment networks without competition from a government-issued digital dollar.
title: US Senate Bans Fed CBDC Until 2030, Boosts Private Stablecoins

details: A framework agreement between the U.S. and Iran, slated for formal signing by June 19, 2026, includes the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and the resumption of Iranian oil exports. This de-escalation has significantly reduced geopolitical risk and inflationary pressures from energy markets, causing oil prices to drop. The shift is fostering a "risk-on" sentiment across global markets, leading to rebounds in equities and a brief rally in Bitcoin towards $67,000, as investors unwind previous "war trade" positions.
title: US-Iran Peace Deal Eases Oil Prices, Fuels Risk-On Bid in Equities & Crypto
